text:
Elsa (Design): Quick design review for the tokens page — sketching a small change to the create/rotate flow to improve transparency around who can see secrets. want quick eyes.
Rahul (PM): dropping in. main concern: avoid adding extra clicks for power users while keeping it auditable.
Jamie (Eng): FYI: current 'Reveal' drawer is implemented as ephemeral modal that only shows secret once after creation. changes could touch analytics and copy.
Maya (A11y): Can we ensure the reveal is announced by screen readers and that focus returns to the primary button? Also check color contrast on the warning strip.
Elsa (Design): Proposal: when creating a token, show a small inline 'visibility matrix' row: "Who can view" with two options — "Only me (ephemeral)" and "Team admins (recorded)". Selecting Team admins shows a caution banner and a 'Why recorded?' tooltip.
Rahul (PM): Love the matrix. Product question: default to "Only me"? That's safer but might generate support chat if teams expect shareable tokens.
Jamie (Eng): Defaulting to 'Only me' is lower risk. If we add 'Team admins', backend needs to persist the secret in vault and log access. That's doable but probably a backend story (audit events + KMS policy).
Elsa (Design): For copy: current reveal CTA is "Show secret" — thinking instead: primary = "Copy token (shown once)", secondary = "View and audit options". This clarifies ephemeral nature.
Maya (A11y): "(shown once)" is great. Also recommend aria-live=\"polite\" on the drawer content and an sr-only hint when copying: "Token copied to clipboard".
Jamie (Eng): Implementation note: clipboard copy triggers can be noisy on mobile. We should keep both copy and a small download (.env) option. That download should also be announced.
Rahul (PM): UX question: rotation flow — when rotating a token, do we keep old token active for a grace window? current product has immediate revoke unless you enable soft-delete.
Elsa (Design): Propose a progressive disclosure: rotate modal with a toggle "Grace period (soft-revoke)" and an inline explanation: "Keep old token valid for X hours to allow rollout; recommended: 24h". Expose default 24h but allow override.
Jamie (Eng): Backend can support configurable grace windows per org, but UI needs to warn about security tradeoffs. Add an inline risk tag: red dot + "Increases attack window".
Maya (A11y): For the modal, ensure keyboard focus lands on the confirm CTA and that pressing Esc reads announcement: "Rotation modal closed". Also the toggle should be accessible as a checkbox with aria-describedby pointing to the explanation.
Elsa (Design): Another microcopy tweak: the current revoke confirmation says "Are you sure?" — too vague. Suggest: "Revoke token: This will immediately disable all clients using this token." and a secondary line for recoverability: "You can undo within 30 minutes" (only when soft-delete enabled).
Rahul (PM): Undo window decision: ops prefers 15m, support prefers 24h. We should propose 24h for soft-deletes and 15m for hard immediate revoke. Need to sync with security.
Jamie (Eng): We can ship soft-delete with 24h default and a feature flag to change per org. Also add an event: `token.revoked.soft` vs `token.revoked.hard` in audit logs.
Elsa (Design): Visual affordances: small pill showing token status on the list row: "Active", "Pending rotate", "Revoked (soft)" with tooltip explaining next steps. Row density needs to stay compact — keep pill small and use hover to show full details.
Maya (A11y): Tooltips must be keyboard focusable. Use `role=\"tooltip\"` and ensure high contrast text.
Rahul (PM): Quick ask: team, could you mock up 2 variants? Variant A: inline matrix during create. Variant B: modal-only options during create. We'll A/B test for time-to-first-use and support tickets.
Jamie (Eng): I'll estimate backend changes after seeing mocks. For Variant A might add 2 more API fields: `visibility` and `audit_recording`.
Elsa (Design): I'll post two small Figma frames later today. Comments welcome on copy:.
Elsa (Design): Copy candidates:
- Create success toast: "Token created — this is the only time you'll see it. Copy now or Download .env"
- Visibility tooltip: "Only you: token shown once, not stored in readable form. Team admins: stored and auditable."
- Rotate modal CTA: "Rotate token (enable grace period)" with toggle label "Keep old token active for 24h"
Rahul (PM): Those read well. Add a short link to docs: "token lifecycle" in the success toast so teams can read about audit implications.
Maya (A11y): For the toast, include a visible close button with accessible name and ensure it doesn't auto-dismiss too quickly. Also, when the token is revealed, provide an accessible confirmation that the secret will not be shown again.
Jamie (Eng): Ops-bot note: `ops-bot`: "Heads up: feature will require audit-log storage, KMS ACLs changes, and maybe a new retention flag. Marking as infra-impacting."
Rahul (PM): Great — next steps: Elsa shares mocks, Jamie returns backend estimate, Maya lists a11y checklist, I'll schedule a 30m sync with security to sign off on default windows.
Elsa (Design): Thanks all. Posting Figma in 30. :sparkles:
Maya (A11y): Thanks! Small nit: change 'Download .env' to 'Download .env (contains token)' so it's explicit.
Jamie (Eng): noted. will include in estimation.
ops-bot: Deploy bot scheduled: token-visibility-proposal -> epic-342 queued for triage.
